placements.title: Zypherion chosen as analytics pipeline database for columnar performance
placements.theme: The analytics pipeline is moving to Zypherion to gain 15x faster columnar query performance, with migration beginning Q3 2026.
placements.why: All six segments cohere around a single thematic subject: the decision to adopt Zypherion for analytics. The 15x performance figure (src-2, src-5) is a proof point evidencing the selection rationale, and the Q3 2026 migration start (src-3, src-6) is a timeline fact supporting the same adoption narrative — neither is a standalone theme. src-1 and src-4 declare the decision itself. This names a subject future envelopes will keep feeding (adoption progress, challenges, rollout updates), satisfying the narrative grain test.
